name: Glide
summary: No-code platform that turns spreadsheets or prompts into business apps and AI agents.
description: Glide builds business apps and AI agents from Excel files, Google Sheets or a prompt, so operations teams can replace spreadsheet workflows. Apps run on the web and on mobile, and an iPhone app is announced. The Free plan has limited credits; Basic costs $25 per month, Plus $50 and Pro $125 per month, with enterprise plans on request. The platform targets teams whose operations run on spreadsheets.
